description: Shaun Finnie argues that Texas Congressional District 2 needs a representative who addresses the economic pressures affecting families instead of exploiting cultural divisions. The former investment banker centers his campaign on rebuilding the middle class, lowering healthcare and housing costs, strengthening public education, supporting childcare, and creating an economy in which working people can prosper […]
